name: font_scale_and_list_row_height_confirmed_002
reference: https://github.com/J0-o/KotorUniResPatch ("2x Font", "2x List Item Height") — independently re-verified against our own executable before use, not copied blindly

hooks.name: generic_list_row_height_setup
hooks.scaling_method: fild/fmul/fistp on the integer height value, reusing the same embedded scale constant as the font hooks (single source of truth)

new_section.name: .kfs
new_section.note: code|execute|read|write, unlike the read-only .kui map section — needs write access for the mutable dedup table

layout.after: TextOutA stub, then Draw stub, then list-row stub

dedup_design.why_required: TextOutA and Draw run every rendered frame; CAurFontInfo instances are shared/persistent and mutated in place. Without de-duplication the fields would be multiplied again on every call and grow without bound within seconds.
dedup_design.behavior_on_overflow: silently stops scaling new (never-before-seen) CAurFontInfo instances once 64 distinct pointers are tracked; already-scaled instances are unaffected

excluded_changes: dialogue letterbox sizing (separate patch, see confirmed_letterbox_patch.json)
computer.gui / computercamera.gui positioning (GUI resource fix, not an executable hook)
per-glyph advance-width tables, if any exist separately from CAurFontInfo (unconfirmed, see reverse-engineering/font.md Known unknowns)

validation.method: manual playtest screenshots at 3440x1440, not automated
